clues: Nico browsed either the maps section or the travel section.
The patron in hiking boots came in earlier than whoever browsed the history section.
The 2:30 p.m. patron was neither Greta nor Oscar.
Of Greta and the patron in rubber boots, one came by at 1:00 p.m. and the other at 2:30 p.m.
Of the patrons in the history and poetry sections, one came by at 1:30 p.m. and the other at 3:00 p.m.
Whoever wore snow boots came by at neither 1:30 p.m. nor 3:00 p.m.
The 3:00 p.m. patron, Oscar, the patron in hiking boots, Nico, and the one in the travel section were five different people.
Of the patron in work boots and the 3:00 p.m. patron, one was Pearl and the other was Greta.
hints: Look at Greta in clue 4. Which two times does it leave her, and does another clue rule one of them out?
Two clues together: clues 3 and 4 both talk about 2:30, so read them side by side for Greta. Then see what clue 8 says about 3:00.
Clue 3 keeps Greta off 2:30, so clue 4 puts her at 1:00 and the rubber boots at 2:30. Then clue 8 gives Pearl 3:00 and Greta the work boots.
By clues 4, 6, 7 and 8, Pearl's 3:00 boots were cowboy. Oscar's were not hiking (clue 7) or the 2:30 rubber (clue 3), so snow.

solution.key_idea: Clues 3 and 4 put Greta at 1:00, so clue 8 gives 3:00 to Pearl and the work boots to Greta.
steps: Clue 1 gives Nico the maps or travel, and clue 7 keeps him from travel. So Nico browsed the maps.
Clue 3 keeps Greta off 2:30, so by clue 4 Greta came at 1:00 and the rubber boots at 2:30.
By clue 8, the 3:00 patron was Pearl or Greta, so Pearl. Clue 8 then gives Greta the work boots.
Pearl's 3:00 boots were not rubber, hiking (clue 7), snow (clue 6) or work. So Pearl wore cowboy boots.
Oscar wore snow boots: clue 3 keeps him off the 2:30 rubber, clue 7 rules out hiking, and cowboy and work are taken.
Clue 7 keeps Nico out of the hiking boots, so Nico wore rubber, at 2:30, and Milo wore hiking.
By clue 6, Oscar's snow boots came at 2:00, the only time left for them. So Milo came at 1:30.
Clue 2 puts history later than Milo's hiking boots, so by clue 5 Pearl had history and Milo poetry. Clue 7 gives Greta travel; Oscar, cooking.
solution.epilogue: Nico came straight off the boat, mud and all, to check a chart in the maps section and return an overdue whale book. He waxed Wren's floor again himself the next morning.

answer_line: Nico tracked in the mud with his rubber boots.
